permission.title: Enable site notifications
permission.body: Get instant alerts for Orders, payments, and deliveries even when you are on another tab. You can change this later in settings.

browser.title: Browser notifications
browser.intro: Desktop alerts appear when a new notification arrives while you are signed in. In-app notifications (the bell) always stay on.
browser.unsupported: Your browser does not support desktop notifications.
browser.toastUnsupported: This browser does not support desktop notifications.
browser.toastDenied: Permission was not granted. You can enable it in browser settings.
browser.toastDisabled: Browser notifications turned off in the app. You may also need to disable them in browser settings.
browser.toastNeedPermission: Allow notifications in the browser first.
browser.testBody: If you see this alert, browser notifications are working.

page.confirmDeleteBody: {{count}} notification(s) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
